title: Canonical Cast / Production Event
description: The canonical event emitted by every ingestion source — simulator, public-data importer, manual entry, and (in v2) live MES. The DPP generator consumes this to mint a canonical Vedanta zinc/lead/silver passport. The HZL term for a 'cast' is a smelter pour, refinery cast or alloying batch depending on the site function.

trackingId.description: Idempotency key — repeat submissions with the same trackingId return the prior result.

actor.description: User or system that fired the event

presetId.description: If kind=simulator, the preset that was fired (e.g. zinc-ecozen-shg-99-995, zinc-cgg-jumbo, lead-pure-99-99)

publicSourceUrl.description: If kind=public_data, the URL the values were extracted from

occurredAt.description: When the cast event physically occurred (not when ingested).

gradeCode.description: HZL grade code, e.g. EcoZen-SHG, CGG, Lead-99.99, SHG, HG, PW, HZDA3, HZDA5, Silver-9999

bundleMassKg.description: Mass of the shipping bundle. If omitted, defaults to 1000 kg or single-unit mass for jumbos.

siteBpns.description: BPNS of the producing site (Chanderiya / Dariba / Debari / Pantnagar)

overrides.description: Free-form overrides for workshop / configurator scenarios. Generator merges over reference data.
